- **Reading a RocksDB file no longer instantiates arbitrary classes** (CWE-502, [GHSA-q86x-r2q3-vf4p](https://github.com/nitrite/nitrite-java/security/advisories/GHSA-q86x-r2q3-vf4p))
- Classes registered with `registerSerializer(...)` are read as before. A class stored by name must now be a Nitrite, JDK or `kotlin.collections` type, or match the patterns given to the new `KryoObjectFormatter(String allowedClasses)`, e.g. `new KryoObjectFormatter("com.example.model.**")`, passed to `RocksDBModuleBuilder.obj
- **Closing an MVStore database no longer fails intermittently with `AssertionError: 0 != 1`** (Windows CI, `TransactionTest.testRollbackDropCollection`)

- **An index still in the list layout is migrated the first time it is accessed** and the legacy map dropped, the way the composite layout already migrates a non-unique index. `IndexMap` exposes the single-id map to the scanner and the filters as one-element lists, so the read path is unchanged. The map has its own name because the RocksDB adapter decodes values by the declared type of the map they live in.
